entities.summary: Rainbow Warrior is a purpose-built motor-assisted sailing yacht owned and operated by Greenpeace and intended for use in their activities such as environmental protests and scientific excursions. She was christened on October 14, 2011, replacing Rainbow Warrior II after further upgrades and maintenance to the older ship had been shown to be impractical.
